event.name: Builders Campfire
event.description:
An intimate night for founders, engineers, and creators building the future

​The best products are built when ambitious people come together.

​Builder Campfire is a private gathering for founders, engineers, and creators to connect through real conversations, shared experiences, and the stories behind the things they build.

​This is not another networking event.

​No awkward introductions.
No endless pitches.
No collecting random LinkedIn connections.

​Just a room full of builders sharing ideas, lessons, challenges, and opportunities.
event.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108
